title: Reduce total model work during blocked execution

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: **Caught**.

Story: `SEED-356#reduce-total-model-work-during-blocked-execution`, selected revision `155ca7231a100cafc769d772b0081bf09dbf28f5`. Sources: `.planning/seeds/SEED-356-reduce-blocked-execution-effort.md` and `.planning/slice-plans/627-reduce-blocked-execution-work/PLAN.md`. This checks retained infrastructure under the explicit early-convergence outcome; it establishes no original model-work saving.

Selected promise: a forked worker retains its own identity, ancestry and lifecycle despite copied parent metadata/history; accounting includes the parent and child responses once. Missing lifecycle/counter evidence remains unknown. The caller's suggested promise, fault and focused test were validated and used without consequential revision.

The maintained check was `caffeinate -s -i node --test Distribution/tests/support/native-comparison-archive-usage.test.mjs`, run in a complete isolated `git archive` snapshot of the selected revision. Its exact wire fixture puts child metadata first, copied coordinator metadata/history next, then a child settings event and child turn. The installed selector resolved this test to MakeMe:true/pageObjects:false; no maintained tests, fixtures or assertions were edited.

One scratch fault changed `Distribution/tests/support/native-host-stream-codex-session.mjs:39`: replacing `if (thread === undefined)` with an unconditional block let each later `session_meta` overwrite `thread` and `parentThread`. The remaining parsing and accounting code stayed intact. Restoration was arranged with finally/exit/signal cleanup before mutation.

Baseline: both maintained tests passed, exit 0, runner duration 102.780083 ms. A separate observation script wrote the same decisive raw wire ordering and called the actual exported reader and `retainedUsage`, without using the maintained assertions. It observed child/coordinator ownership, child-turn start/completion, two responses and complete totals `{input_tokens:27,cached_input_tokens:14,output_tokens:5,total_tokens:32}`.

Faulted observation: metadata remained ordered child then coordinator, and the child settings event was present, but the reader reported worker thread `coordinator`, null parent, startedTurns `["root-turn"]`, completedTurns `[]`. Both raw response records were present, yet retained accounting returned only one response, status `unknown`, totals null. This directly establishes wrong ownership/lifecycle/accounting on the intended copied-metadata path.

The same maintained command exited 1: its first test, “fork accounting owns the child lifecycle and counts copied parent responses only once,” failed at `Distribution/tests/support/native-comparison-archive-usage.test.mjs:78`, `assert.equal(usage.status, "complete")`, with actual `unknown`. That earlier status assertion caught the fault before its later ownership/totals assertions ran. The second test, covering unfinished child/missing counter evidence, passed. Faulted runner duration: 140.500958 ms. The verdict is bounded to this observed metadata-overwrite fault and exercised wire ordering.

Restoration: the original source bytes were restored, then the identical maintained command passed 2/2, exit 0, runner duration 130.088917 ms. The separate witness again returned child/coordinator ownership, child-turn lifecycle, two responses and complete totals 27/14/5/32. All 6,579 snapshot file-content hashes matched the pre-probe manifest. Source SHA-256 before/after: `ba4a6ebc375cad5b910949d5ddaa05448404199c2eec610c2e860ee8f6de7894`; maintained-test SHA-256 before/after: `113bd94ca8e916f847384e6a4c3191ee67d5dc49e5326e39bd7931714e2b41e4`. The scratch snapshot, witness, data, logs and location marker were removed and their absence verified. The execution checkout remained at the selected revision with empty porcelain status. No root edit, commit, publication, observer action, paid/native model launch, broad test run or additional agent was used.

Next proof action: retain the existing focused assertion; this probe supports no repair or broader check for this specific fault. Caller owns persistence, disposition and any further coverage decision.

Prior disposition: this matches the already-authorized retention of repaired fork/worker accounting and its focused proof. It creates no new implementation decision and does not resume the retired native benchmark or queued third attempt.

Resource context: AC power, 16 CPUs, 48 GiB RAM, 47% memory free; observed load 45.60/18.84/10.56 with other owners' load generators/focused browser work. Only the small builtin-Node checks ran, under the maintained AC sleep guard. No sleeps, test.slow calls or timeout changes.

- **Test runtime.** 373.369958 ms total (measured from Node runner durations): baseline 102.780083 ms, faulted 140.500958 ms, restored 130.088917 ms. This excludes lookup/setup, witness calls and report production.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable in labor minutes: no separate human timing was supplied or recorded. Zero new human interactions were requested during this probe (measured from its transcript).
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable in active compute time, tokens or charge: no per-probe meter was exposed. One agent and zero additional delegates executed the probe (measured from its transcript); elapsed time is reported separately.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 224552 ms (measured), from 1794729104000 to 1794729328552 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
